title: VN with AI generated cats, looking for playtesters!
author: Visible-Key-1320
selftext:
We just released the playtest-ready demo for our visual and I thought I'd check in to see if anyone's interested in playtesting. We spent a long time developing the art style with a workflow that includes both human and AI-generated art, and a whole lot of compositing. We'd love to hear what you think of the style used throughout the game!

Let me know if you're interested in playtesting, and I can provide the link and password.

comments.author: Limp_Biscuit_Choco
comments.body: Looking at the picture, it does look really good. I would suggest launching this on platforms like vibecodinglist for real user feedback from explorers, as well as the other builders tho.

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: you wanna give it a shot?

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: messaged you! thank you so much!

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: The concept looks really unique, mixing mystery and romance with that kind of art style. How long does the demo take to finish? I’d love to see how the AI-generated art blends into the storytelling.

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: sent you a message, thank you!
